Sach ke bina himmat bekaar hai.
Hard dinon pe aa jana—grit.
Shaant logon ke dimaag shor karte hain.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
Jab sab haar maan lein, tabhi asli grit dikhta hai.
He who has overcome apne fears karega, tabhi truly free hoga.
Grit luck nahi; kaam hai.
Grit hai lagatar chalna choose karna.
Himmat impossible ko doable banati.
Aag mein bhi shaant rehna himmat hai.
Himmat dar ka ilaaj hai.
Himmat pehla insani gun hai—kyunki ye baaki sabki guarantee karta hai.
Kinaare par jahaz surakshit rehta hai, par woh iske liye nahi bana hota.
Courage: afraid hoke bhi wahi karna.
Grit ka matlab hai raaste par tikna.
Grit grind ko respect karti hai.
Kiye gaye chhote kaam un badi yojnaon se behtar hain jo sirf soche gaye hain.
Grit pressure mein strength hai.
Khamoshi choice hai, khaali-pan nahi.
